findings.F1: On Sunday bars the coin's next 3-day return against its drift, in usual 3-day moves, falls with the Sunday return in usual daily moves (slope -0.106, t -6.2, 4320 Sunday cases 7 bars apart), while every other weekday shows no reversal or a continuation (Monday -0.019 t -1.35, Tuesday -0.006 t -0.37, Wednesday +0.031 t 2.30, Thursday -0.011 t -0.83, Friday +0.042 t 3.36, Saturday +0.038 t 2.13).
findings.F2: The Sunday reversal is graded and works on both sides of zero, with moderate moves. The next 3-day excess return, in usual 3-day moves, is +0.27 after Sunday z in (-1.5,-1] (n 232), +0.16 in (-1,-0.5] (n 691), +0.06 in (-0.5,0] (n 1066), -0.10 in (0,0.5] (n 1040), -0.10 in (0.5,1] (n 637) and -0.16 in (1,1.5] (n 284). So Sunday rises are faded as much as Sunday falls rebound, and the tested idea is long-only and leaves that side out.
findings.F3: The reversal does not carry into the largest Sunday falls: z in (-3,-2] gives -0.18 (n 63) and (-2,-1.5] gives +0.13 (n 74), against +0.27 for (-1.5,-1]. This is consistent with the tested idea's cubic weighting on the largest falls failing its top-quartile check (Welch t -1.80) while its weighted mean passed (t 3.65).
findings.F4: Only Sunday's own day reverses. The two-day Saturday-to-Sunday return in usual moves has no slope on the next 3 days (-0.014, t -0.76, n 4320), and the Saturday bar's move continues (+0.038, t 2.13).
findings.F5: Weekend volume does not grade the rebound after Sunday falls (z < -1), contrary to the brief: low-volume tertile +0.13 (t 1.55, n 124), middle +0.19, high-volume +0.20 (t 1.46, n 126).
findings.F6: The rebound after Sunday falls (z < -1) sits in coins already down over 20 days, at +0.34 usual 3-day moves (t 2.83, n 127), against -0.004 (t -0.04, n 127) in coins up over 20 days. It is also stronger in calm than in turbulent volatility (+0.21 t 2.17 vs +0.02 t 0.14). Both are tertile splits among many angles, so they are suggestive only.
findings.F7: The rebound after Sunday falls is unstable by year: +1.17 in 2021 (t 3.76), -0.83 in 2018 (t -3.77, n 13), -0.17 in 2022 (n 74). The book earns most on Mondays: mean daily book return +0.094 % against the coins' -0.035 % (n 5270).

ideas.idea: A coin's Sunday close-to-close return, measured in its usual daily moves over the past 20 days, is followed over the next 3 days (Monday to Wednesday) by a move against the coin's normal drift in the opposite direction. The larger the Sunday move, the larger the reversal, both after Sunday rises and after Sunday falls.
ideas.consequence: Lean against Sunday's move in either direction for the first three weekdays, fading Sunday rises as well as buying Sunday falls, and lean harder the larger the Sunday move.
ideas.name: Sunday move reverses both ways

ideas.idea: A coin's Friday close-to-close return, measured in its usual daily moves over the past 20 days, continues in the same direction over the next 3 days (Saturday to Monday). The larger the Friday move, the larger the continuation.
ideas.consequence: Go with Friday's move into the weekend rather than against it, and keep the weekend reversal trade for Sunday's move only.
ideas.name: Friday move continues weekend

ideas.idea: After a Sunday fall, the rise over the next 3 days (Monday to Wednesday) against the coin's normal drift is larger the further the coin had fallen over the previous 20 days, measured in its usual daily moves.
ideas.consequence: Buy Sunday falls in coins already in a 20-day decline, and refuse them in coins that have been rising.
ideas.name: Sunday fall rebounds in downtrend
